question: In which year was All-India Muslim League formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1906.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** All-India Muslim League** was formed in the year **1906.**
 
• It was formed in **Dhaka, Bangladesh** during the British Raj.
 
• The main objective of the league was to protect the** political rights of Muslims** in India and to prevent their **marginalization **in the Hindu-dominated **Indian National Congress.**
 
• The league played a crucial role in the creation of **Pakistan in 1947,** which was a separate **Muslim-majority state **at the time of partition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian National Congress** was formed in **1885** to represent the interests of the Indian people in the **British colonial government.**
 
• **1911 **is significant because it was the year when the **capital of British** India was shifted from** Calcutta to Delhi.**
 
• **1920 **is significant because it was the year when Mahatma Gandhi launched his** non-cooperation movement** against the British government, which was a major turning point in India's struggle for independence.
